title: An actual mall this time
content: So I had a dream involving an actual mall, and the town I was born in. I had a lot of trouble remembering this dream after I woke up and the details have been slowly coming back to me throughout the day. I finally have enough to share, but it's still in pieces compared to other dreams. It started in the mall. It was like a regular mall pretty much, just a single story and contained rows and rows of stores, the usual. But it had this striking floor. Polished, shiny, that kind of thin tile a lot of mall floors have, but it had these green and yellow zig-zags. It really stood out. Walking through the mall there were a lot of stores with neon lights outlining the entrance. I walked through the mall for some time, but didn't find anything I wanted to buy. I exited a different way than the one I came in, and it opened up to the downtown square of the town I was born in, which surprised me. By this point the mall had disappeared, so I had no choice but to go along with it. The square was just like I remembered it when I was a kid. Granted, it hasn't changed that much IRL. I went and stood outside the [theater](https://sah-archipedia.org/sites/default/files/pictures/full/AR-01-BO2-001.jpg) and thought about my next move, since I had to get back home. I decided to try and find a taxi or bus. I found a taxi and paid for the rather long trip back home and suddenly passed out as soon as I closed the door. When I came to, I was back in the same mall as before. Someone came up to me and asked me to go on a mission of some kind. I don't remember what happened in between then and the next scene, but I know there was a lot of adventuring. The last thing I remember is that I was in a room with this random adventure partner, and we were observing some police officers that had been chained to chairs and repeatedly tortured with electric shocks, and the adventurer turned to me and said "they're called Dancing Spiders. Spiders because they tried to trap us in their web, dancing because, well look at them."
